newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- An police lieutenant has been detained for selling information to three civilians as to whom the police were watching in connection with the current spate of gang shootings and bombings in Budapest
- Haulage company Hungarocamion has suspended deliveries to Russia because the Ukraine and Belarus stopped 60 Hungarian trucks on the border.
- Pension reform could stimulate the economy by one to one and a half percent after 2000, the finance ministry said.
- Trade union federation MSZOSZ has initiated negotiations with goverment experts on how to ease burdens to the population resulting from the forthcoming rises in retail energy prices.
- According to a Budapest court there is no legal obstacle to the Christian Democrat People's Party holding a session of its national executive this weekend.
